title: The Sands of Time
author: Made with Nanik
paragraphs: Little Sandwich sat on a Mars dune, its crust warm from the twin suns. A tiny sigh escaped its fillings. "Oh, I wish I could be at the Crystal Caves right now!" it mumbled, its googly eyes staring. "This waiting is truly the hardest part of any journey. So many crunchy crumbs to find, but it feels so far away."[SCENE_BREAK]Suddenly, a clear voice echoed from a tall rock pillar.

"Waiting can be quite wonderful, if you know how to look at it!" A small, gleaming metal door, no bigger than a button, shimmered into view on the rock face, pulsing with soft light. Little Sandwich wobbled. "Goodness! Who in the universe said that?"[SCENE_BREAK]The tiny door clicked open with a soft ping, letting a sliver of rainbow light out. "Why, I did!" chirped the same sweet, silvery voice.

Little Sandwich peered closer. Inside, glowing gears and shimmering sands stretched. From the light buzzed a bright-eyed robotic beetle, no bigger than a thumb, its antennae wiggling. "Are you heading to the Crystal Caves too?"[SCENE_BREAK]"Oh, I want to, very much," Little Sandwich replied, a bit sadly. "But it feels like forever until I get there.
The path is simply too long!" The little beetle zipped out, hovering. "Oh, no, it's never forever! It's just a matter of finding the right coordination! Come, let me show you.

Watch how I tap my tiny, strong legs."[SCENE_BREAK]The beetle began tapping its six metallic legs on the red rock, creating a gentle, rhythmic 'click-clack, click-clack.' It explained, "If you move your boots just like my legs, and click your crumbs together at exactly the same pace, a special path will appear.

It's a secret rhythm for patience!" Little Sandwich tried its best, tapping its little boots, 'toom-tap, toom-tap," and clicking its crumbs, 'clink-clank, clink-clank.'[SCENE_BREAK]Soon, a steady, calm rhythm filled the Martian air, perfectly matching the beetle's taps. The air around the glowing door began to ripple and shimmer with soft, rainbow hues.

The doorway itself grew wider and brighter, unfolding into a magnificent, sparkling tunnel filled with light. The little beetle hovered proudly. "See? It's all about finding your calm rhythm. Are you ready to finally go through?"[SCENE_BREAK]"Yes! Oh, yes, I am ready now!" Little Sandwich chirped back, a new feeling of calm excitement rippling through its delicious layers. It felt a steady beat in its core.

Little Sandwich marched, its coordination perfect, through the beautiful, ever-widening doorway, its happy clicks and taps echoing softly as it entered the glimmering tunnel that promised the wondrous Crystal Caves.[SCENE_BREAK]Did you like the story? Come back tomorrow, and you will find out what amazing, glowing colors Little Sandwich saw first inside the Crystal Caves!
